searchText: The number of requests in the queue is very helpful to calculate when a request gets dequeued and processed by the consensus layer.. I get the Idea of not duplicating the fee logic, and appreciate that. But the number of entries should still be available somehow, as going back from the fee to that number is impossible. <@808969530608451584> is this about checking the number of queued items through RPC? If so, this can be done by reading storage.
